comment:
* A class which allows custom selection of colors in a {@link Palette}'s generation. Instances * can be created via the {@link Builder} class. * *

To use the target, use the {@link Palette.Builder#addTarget(Target)} API when building a * Palette.

variables.name: LIGHT_VIBRANT
variables.comment: * A target which has the characteristics of a vibrant color which is light in luminance.

variables.name: VIBRANT
variables.comment: * A target which has the characteristics of a vibrant color which is neither light or dark.

variables.name: DARK_VIBRANT
variables.comment: * A target which has the characteristics of a vibrant color which is dark in luminance.

variables.name: LIGHT_MUTED
variables.comment: * A target which has the characteristics of a muted color which is light in luminance.

variables.name: MUTED
variables.comment: * A target which has the characteristics of a muted color which is neither light or dark.

variables.name: DARK_MUTED
variables.comment: * A target which has the characteristics of a muted color which is dark in luminance.

methods.name: public float getMinimumSaturation()
methods.comment: * The minimum saturation value for this target.

methods.name: public float getTargetSaturation()
methods.comment: * The target saturation value for this target.

methods.name: public float getMaximumSaturation()
methods.comment: * The maximum saturation value for this target.

methods.name: public float getMinimumLightness()
methods.comment: * The minimum lightness value for this target.

methods.name: public float getTargetLightness()
methods.comment: * The target lightness value for this target.

methods.name: public float getMaximumLightness()
methods.comment: * The maximum lightness value for this target.

methods.name: public float getSaturationWeight()
methods.comment:
* Returns the weight of importance that this target places on a color's saturation within * the image. * *

The larger the weight, relative to the other weights, the more important that a color * being close to the target value has on selection.

* * @see #getTargetSaturation()

methods.name: public float getLightnessWeight()
methods.comment:
* Returns the weight of importance that this target places on a color's lightness within * the image. * *

The larger the weight, relative to the other weights, the more important that a color * being close to the target value has on selection.

* * @see #getTargetLightness()

methods.name: public float getPopulationWeight()
methods.comment:
* Returns the weight of importance that this target places on a color's population within * the image. * *

The larger the weight, relative to the other weights, the more important that a * color's population being close to the most populous has on selection.

methods.name: public boolean isExclusive()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether any color selected for this target is exclusive for this target only. * *

If false, then the color can be selected for other targets.
